comment: The welcome picture keeps its height on every pane of the welcome window. A window of the Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus's 2944 by 1840 at the scale of 1.70 Sara starts the tablet at, the welcome window shot on Recent and on Quick settings, where the band was shorter on one pane than another before. Then the same at a scale of 2 on a 1280 by 800 screen, the host too short for the band at its full height, where the band gives way by the same on Quick settings, which the window opens on again because it keeps the pane it was closed on, and on News, the pane with the tallest rows above its scroll.
